summary: Melkor: a bounded C++17 toolkit that inspects, converts and locally views Gaussian-splat assets across PLY, SPZ and glTF, with a stable C ABI, a CLI, JSON schemas, profiles and a local-only viewer. Version 2.0.0-dev has no supported production release. AGENTS.md is the operating contract; this index restates its facts for tools.

entry_documents.role: scope, format contract and C SDK
architecture rules, repository checks and pull request checklist
roles, decisions, independent review and release approval

delivery.merge: Commit, push and merge to main after the local gate; self-merge is the normal path and is not peer review. A design-first change needs a written proposal and explicit maintainer agreement first.
delivery.signing: required: sign every commit; the repository configuration signs with the owner's SSH key
delivery.attribution: no AI attribution or co-author trailers
